This is the primary reason I bought it. Even if it doesn't have a finished camper, I can still go when the apocalypse arrives.

The challenge is going to be avoiding standard roads and choke points during if all of civilization goes belly up. Any running vehicle will be a target but a behemoth like this will be worth more than most any other kind of vehicle. So this is the "I'm never coming home" vehicle. And that's the idea. Get to your target location, live out of it while you make something more permanent. Once you're there, disassemble the camper to use as materials for building a permanent shelter. Hence why I'm leaning strongly towards a metal frame and metal siding - great structure and roofing material. So... outside would be metal sheets (roof), inside would be plywood or wooden boards (walls), remove the solar and water collection for the permanent shelter. That leaves you with a vehicle that you can then use for power, heat, air tools, scouting and recon, bring back supplies, moving trees and rocks/boulders.

It's literally a portable home.

But until then... CAMPING AND ROADTRIPS!
